title: Glowing pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF7AA' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE94D' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pencilBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD93B'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFCC00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8A800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wood' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F2C98A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D9A45E'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lead' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7B6FD0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5A4FB0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Soft glow around pencil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='44' ry='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Pencil body (main barrel) -->
  <g transform='rotate(-40 50 50)'>
    <!-- Barrel -->
    <rect x='30' y='20' width='18' height='56' rx='2' fill='url(#pencilBody)'/>
    <!-- Highlight stripe -->
    <rect x='34' y='20' width='4' height='56' rx='1' fill='#FFF08A' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- Shade stripe -->
    <rect x='44' y='20' width='3' height='56' fill='#D69500' opacity='0.6'/>

    <!-- Metal ferrule -->
    <rect x='30' y='14' width='18' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#C8CDD6'/>
    <rect x='30' y='14' width='18' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E8ECF2'/>
    <rect x='30' y='21' width='18' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9AA3AF'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='14' x2='34' y2='24' stroke='#9AA3AF' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='40' y1='14' x2='40' y2='24' stroke='#9AA3AF' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='14' x2='46' y2='24' stroke='#9AA3AF' stroke-width='1'/>

    <!-- Eraser -->
    <rect x='31' y='5' width='16' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
    <rect x='31' y='5' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFB3C1'/>

    <!-- Sharpened tip (wood) -->
    <polygon points='30,76 48,76 39,92' fill='url(#wood)'/>
    <polygon points='34,76 44,76 39,86' fill='#F7D9A8' opacity='0.7'/>

    <!-- Graphite lead tip -->
    <polygon points='36.5,82 41.5,82 39,92' fill='url(#lead)'/>
    <polygon points='38,86 40,86 39,92' fill='#9C8FE8'/>

    <!-- Sparkle at tip -->
    <g opacity='0.9'>
      <polygon points='39,96 40,93 41,96 44,97 41,98 40,100 39,98 36,97' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
    </g>
    <circle cx='39' cy='95' r='5' fill='#FFF8C4' opacity='0.35'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Extra sparkles around the pencil -->
  <g fill='#FFF6A8'>
    <polygon points='24,30 25.5,26.5 27,30 30.5,31.5 27,33 25.5,36.5 24,33 20.5,31.5' opacity='0.9'/>
    <polygon points='72,68 73,65 74,68 77,69 74,70 73,73 72,70 69,69' opacity='0.8'/>
    <polygon points='68,28 69,25.5 70,28 72.5,29 70,30 69,32.5 68,30 65.5,29' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='70' r='2' opacity='0.6'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='42' r='1.8' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
